name: animated-toast-stack
title: Animated Toast Stack
description: A stack of toasts that spring in with a blur, swap their icon and text in place, swipe away and expire on a timer. Includes a hook to drive it.

props.name: toasts
props.description: Toasts to show, oldest first: { id, title, description?, status?, icon?, action?, duration?, dismissible? }.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when a toast is swiped or closed. Without it the close button and swipe are off.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner or edge when placement is fixed or absolute; bottom positions also grow upward.

props.name: placement
props.description: How the stack is positioned. Defaults to fixed when `fixed` is set, otherwise static.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Shortcut for placement fixed: pins the stack to the viewport and renders it in a portal.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render into a portal. Defaults to true for fixed placement.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: How many of the newest toasts are shown.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Slot classes: root, item, surface, iconWrap, content, title, description, action, close, progress.

props.name: icons
props.description: Override the icon of a status.
